audience: managers who roster staff and check timesheets in Microkeeper

useCases.title: See who is rostered at a site
useCases.text: List the locations, then read the rostered shifts of every employee at the active locations, for up to 31 days.

useCases.title: Check worked hours for a period
useCases.text: Read the timesheets for up to 31 days, for all staff or for the usernames you choose. Read staff profiles to match names.

useCases.title: Find staff on leave
useCases.text: Read the leave requests that start, end or run through a date range, with their type and status.

useCases.title: Add a new employee or update staff details
useCases.text: Add an employee, or update the fields you send for an existing one. Only the fields you send change. A login email is sent only when you set welcome.

useCases.title: Review jobs and groups
useCases.text: List the jobs by status, and the groups of staff, such as teams and sites.
